author: SirCyaniide
body:
I was on at 11:28:27 when this occurred. Spawned in spawn. And continued my way to the edge of the world where people on MY team were blowing tnt. I placed around 5 tnt blocks and lit them up when Zint Started accusing me of blowing up spawn. About 6 other people were performing this action and one of them blew up spawn. So I do Not understand why blowing up 5-9 tnt block AWAY from spawn is such a offensive action.

Yes I do believe this is an error because I was on that map for less than 5 min which barley is enough time to create a tnt propaganda. And I do believe u have the wrong person :\.
